description: This file defines a report class 'IssueAnalytics' for generating issue analytics reports within the ERPNext system, including methods for data retrieval, processing, and chart data preparation.

classes.name: IssueAnalytics
classes.description: Class responsible for generating issue analytics report, including data fetching, processing, and chart data preparation.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Entry point function that initializes and runs the IssueAnalytics report.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing the report with filters and setting up date ranges.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main method to generate report columns, data, and chart data.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns of the report based on filters.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Fetches issues and prepares report rows.

methods.name: get_period
methods.description: Calculates period labels based on date and report range.

methods.name: get_period_date_ranges
methods.description: Generates date ranges for report periods based on filters.
